instruction: Candid documentary wide full shot of an indoor studio with a red carpet. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, shaking hands with the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) who stands on the right facing left. They clasp right hands under bright overhead lighting.

R2 is the participant facing left toward R1 while their right hands are clasped

R1 and R2 stand facing one another during the hand contact
